subject.title: fix(browser): time out Google Docs page exports

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally fail any authenticated Google Docs text export that has not completed within 30 seconds, rather than continuing to wait for a slow but valid export?
rationale: The code is mechanically narrow, but the timeout chooses a user-visible availability policy that tests and anonymous endpoint probing cannot calibrate.

options.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
options.body: Accept bounded recovery as the product policy after confirming that a 30-second failure is preferable to an indefinitely blocked share flow.

options.title: Choose a different recovery policy
options.body: Specify a different deadline or a narrowly designed retry/feedback policy if slow authenticated exports must remain viable beyond 30 seconds.

options.title: Pause this change
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until owner evidence establishes an appropriate export deadline for real user documents.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Accept bounded recovery as the product policy after confirming that a 30-second failure is preferable to an indefinitely blocked share flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The only identified person connected to the current implementation and its browser-flow evidence is the branch author; feature-history ownership could not be established from the available read-only inspection.
